text: T2's  CSS/class is also used by the independent Reattach comment banner at App.tsx:2633. Removing the CSS leaves that banner unstyled, and the acceptance grep for restore-fragment cannot pass. May I rename only that banner class to  and add an equivalent scoped CSS rule, registering App.tsx and styles.css? This touches outside T2's listed shared-file regions; otherwise please choose whether to preserve/adjust the check or leave that banner impacted.
resolution: Yes to the rename, minus the registering: rename only the banner's className to 'reattach-banner' and convert the .restore-fragment CSS in your region into an equivalent .reattach-banner rule so it looks the same. App.tsx line ~2633 is now part of your regions. Do NOT files-add App.tsx or styles.css; they stay unregistered. Keep the acceptance grep as written. See decision 'W6 T2 reattach banner class'. -- coordinator agent-81bd
